research_scope: Independent Wave2 source-free contextual prerequisite audit. Original formulations, differentiated parent-specific hypotheses, citation provenance, production corpus and consolidation gate are not changed. Human certification is not claimed.

aliases.reason: In the finite-module support and irreducible-component sources, a Zariski-closed subset of Spec(R) has the form V(I)={p in Spec(R): I⊆p}. This is exactly the Zariski vanishing-locus construction V(I) used to define closed sets in the ring-spectrum source. The particular ideal Ann_R(M), Noetherian hypotheses, and irreducible-component condition remain parent-specific.

The constructible-subset-on-affine-spectrum source's V(g_1,...,g_m) consists of primes containing every g_i, identically V((g_1,...,g_m)), the ordinary Zariski-closed-locus V(I) for the finitely generated ideal I. The number of generators, accompanying distinguished open D(f), and finite-union constructibility clause remain the parent's extra structure.

The relative-dimension-at-a-prime source says q in Spec(S) lies over p in Spec(R) for R→S exactly when p is the inverse-image contraction φ^{-1}(q). The relative-assassin source explicitly uses that same contracted prime construction p=q∩R (shorthand along the structure map). Relative dimension, local fibre topology, and associated-prime requirements are separate parent-specific data.

The sigma-algebra source's complement X\A is the general relative set difference A\B specialized to the first set X, the ambient universe. Both definitions use the operation {x in first set : x not in second set}. Measurability, the ambient universe restriction, and the topological-boundary or constructible-set uses remain parent-specific; the alias is for the underlying set-difference prerequisite.

The locally-ringed-space morphism source's compatible structure-sheaf morphism for continuous f:X→Y is the ordinary ring-sheaf map O_Y→f_*O_X, equivalently via sheaf adjunction f^{-1}O_Y→O_X, as stated in the scheme-morphism source. Requiring induced stalk maps to be local homomorphisms and requiring the spaces to be schemes are separate parent conditions.
